mapper.select: SELECT * FROM eb_flower_material_batch WHERE material_id=#{materialId} AND expiry_date >= DATE(#{deliveryDate}) AND received_date <= CURDATE() AND current_qty > reserved_qty ORDER BY expiry_date ASC, received_date ASC, id ASC FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE eb_flower_material_batch SET reserved_qty=reserved_qty+#{quantity}, update_time=NOW() WHERE id=#{batchId} AND #{quantity} > 0 AND current_qty-reserved_qty >= #{quantity}
UPDATE eb_flower_material_batch SET reserved_qty=reserved_qty-#{quantity}, update_time=NOW() WHERE id=#{batchId} AND #{quantity} > 0 AND reserved_qty >= #{quantity}
UPDATE eb_flower_material_batch SET current_qty=#{currentQty}, update_time=NOW() WHERE id=#{batchId} AND #{currentQty} >= 0 AND #{currentQty} >= reserved_qty
